title: Bryan Steil posts on Sikh Gurdwara anniversary, town hall engagement, and tax reform
text:
Bryan Steil, U.S. Representative of Wisconsin's 1st congressional district | Official U.S. House headshot
Bryan Steil, U.S. Representative of Wisconsin's 1st congressional district | Official U.S. House headshot
Bryan Steil, U.S. Congressman for Wisconsin's 1st district and a consistent victor in recent general elections, posted several updates on his social media accounts this week addressing community remembrance, constituent engagement, and tax policy.
On August 5, 2025, Steil commemorated the anniversary of the Oak Creek Sikh Gurdwara tragedy. In his post, he stated: "13 years ago, a tragic act of violence took seven innocent lives at the Oak Creek Sikh Gurdwara. We honor the memory of the victims and stand with their families and the Sikh community." The shooting at the Sikh temple in Oak Creek remains one of Wisconsin's most significant incidents of hate-motivated violence.
Later that day, Steil highlighted his commitment to accessibility with constituents by posting: "It's my priority to be open and accessible. Thanks to everyone who came to our town hall." Town halls are a common method for elected officials to interact directly with residents and address local concerns.
On August 6, 2025, Steil addressed federal tax policy reforms in another post: "Extending the 2017 tax reforms AND reducing taxes on:
Social Security
Tips
Overtime" The reference points to ongoing debates over the future of provisions enacted under the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017.
Steil has maintained his congressional seat through several election cycles. He defeated Randy Bryce in 2018 (54.6% to 42.3%), Roger Polack in 2020 (59.3% to 40.6%), Ann Roe in 2022 (54.1% to 45.1%), and Peter Barca in 2024 (54% to 43.8%).
